body: A small **TypeScript** harness for **Safari on a real iPhone**, over USB or Wi-Fi, or on an iOS Simulator. Agents get an API to navigate, click, type, take screenshots, read the DOM and manage tabs.
It talks to Apple's **W3C WebDriver** server, `safaridriver`, directly, so there is **no Appium and no native app**.
Safari automation is isolated from ordinary browsing data and allows **one session at a time**, and neo keeps both constraints.
